risks.risk: Wrong fitment (vehicle make/model/year) for the steering rack and radiator/condenser; parts may not match mounting points/hoses.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of any part numbers/labels and the mounting ends (tie-rod end type, hose/pipe connections) plus the car details they came from (VIN or at least make/model/year).
risks.if_unproven: Price as scrap/for parts only (no guarantee of correct fit).

risks.risk: Steering rack internal condition (leaks, seized rack, worn bushings) not visible from one photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the rack movement end-to-end and any visible leaks, plus photos of boots and seals.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs overhaul.

risks.risk: Radiator/condenser damage (bent fins, leaks, clogged core) not fully assessable from the single image.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the entire core (top to bottom) and any puncture points, and a pressure-test/flush proof if available.

risks.risk: The lot may not include all items claimed (drive shafts and starter motor) or may be incomplete.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the drive shafts and starter motor (separate clear shots) before agreeing.
risks.if_unproven: Price only what is shown (steering rack + radiator/condenser) and treat missing items as not included.

risks.risk: Condition/quantity mismatch (e.g., only one steering rack or one radiator, not the stated quantities).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing all items laid out together with count visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest quantity consistent with the photo (one steering rack + one radiator/condenser).
